purpose: Read-only Godot 4.x material binding planning after texture, PBR and UV assurance.

guardedWorkflows.directxNormals: Explicit Y/green conversion to Godot OpenGL normal convention is required before normal_texture binding.
guardedWorkflows.opacity: Standalone opacity maps are not silently bound; compose into albedo alpha or use a reviewed custom shader.
guardedWorkflows.specular: Standalone per-pixel specular maps are not silently bound; re-author for metallic/roughness or use a reviewed custom shader.
guardedWorkflows.ormAuthority: Packed ORM and separate AO/roughness/metallic inputs cannot both be authoritative.
